principle_violations.reason: Payment processing logic and user authentication are mixed together within the payment processor classes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the authentication logic into dedicated responsibilities and ensure PaymentProcessor handles only payment initiation.

principle_violations.reason: The DebitPaymentProcessor is tightly coupled to the SMSAuthorizer class, making future changes or substitution of the authorization logic difficult.
principle_violations.suggestion: Inject an interface for authentication at initialization instead of directly using SMSAuthorizer.

overall_feedback: Two principle violations found. See details above.
